name: planted-v2-tempho1995
cmd: set -e; {python} research/exp/planted.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995 --out {cache}/planted_v2_tempho1995 --n-per 60 --seed 1; for arm in A0:iso A3:split; do {python} research/exp/fast_arm.py --cache {cache}/planted_v2_tempho1995 --out {out}/${arm%%:*} --kernel ${arm##*:} --tag planted_v2_${arm%%:*} --dump-change; {python} research/exp/planted_report.py --planted {cache}/planted_v2_tempho1995 --arm {out}/${arm%%:*}; done
